hero.h1: Ejector Pump Repair and Replacement in Elmhurst, IL
hero.sub: An alarm going off, a basement toilet that won't flush or a sewer smell near the basin. We repair and replace ejector pumps for basement bathrooms, laundry and overhead sewer systems. Our office is on York Street, downtown. Open 24/7.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber working on the pump and wiring inside a basement pit

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: Basement fixtures below the sewer line drain into a sealed basin. The ejector pump lifts that wastewater up to the main line, a float tells it when to run and a check valve keeps water from falling back. In homes with an overhead sewer, this pump handles every basement drain.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber working on the discharge pipe of a basement sump pump

blocks.h2: Ejector Pumps in Finished Elmhurst Basements
blocks.body: Many Elmhurst basements have a bathroom or bar sink added during a remodel, and they drain to an ejector pump. When the pump fails, those fixtures back up quickly. We replace failed pumps with units sized for the fixtures, check the alarm and make sure the basin lid seals tightly so odors stay inside. If the basin is hidden behind finished walls, we'll talk about better access.

blocks.h2: Ejector Pump Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.q: The alarm is going off. Can I still use the basement bathroom?
items.answer: No. Stop using every drain that feeds the basin until we fix the pump.

items.q: How long do ejector pumps last?
Why does the basement smell like sewer?
items.preview: A seal, vent or dry trap.
items.answer: Usually a worn lid seal, a vent connection or a dry floor drain trap.

items.q: Can you add a backup to my ejector pit?
items.answer: Some basins can hold a second pump. We'll check yours.

items.q: Why does my ejector pump run so often?
items.preview: A stuck float or bad check valve.
items.answer: Usually a stuck float or a check valve that lets water fall back.

items.q: How much does ejector pump replacement cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on the pump and basin. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the pump, the basin and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
